sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

AN
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HOUSING AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
(Act
XVI of 2014)
to amend the Khyber Pakhtunichwa
Housing Authority Act,
2005.
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Act, 2005 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XI of 2005), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
1. Short title and commencement.---(l) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing
Authority (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XI of 2005

AN
THE KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA HOUSING AUTHORITY
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
(Act XVI of 2014)
to amend the Khyber Pakhtunichwa
Housing Authority Act,
2005.
WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Housing Authority Act, 2005 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Act No. XI of 2005), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:
2. Amendment of section 4 of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No. XI of 2005.---In the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Housing Authority Act, 2005 (Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
Act No. XI of 2005), in section 4, in sub-section (2), after clause (x), the following new clauses shall be added; namely:
"(xi-a) to
prescribe mechanism for acquisition of land, on land sharing basis formula;
(xi-b) deal with the issues relating to
rehabilitation and settlement of landless owners in the prescribed manner;
(xi-c)
prescribe mechanism for payment of compensation to the land owners, whose land
has been acquired;".
BY ORDER OF MR. SPEAKER
PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLY OF KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA
_____________________________________________
(AMANULLAH)
Secretary
Provincial Assembly or Khyber Pakhtunkhwa,
